	desc = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_desc
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_accept
		trigger = {
			tag = SVN
			VIE = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_eligible = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_025_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_paris_idea }
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_settlement_idea }
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_idea }
				tag = VIE
				SVN = { exists = yes }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_offer_pending
			}
		}
		effect_tooltip = {
			VIE = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.025 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_idea days = 270 }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = SVN
					VIE = {
						COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_eligible = yes
						custom_trigger_tooltip = {
							tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_025_tt
							check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						}
						NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_paris_idea }
						NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_settlement_idea }
						NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_idea }
						tag = VIE
						SVN = { exists = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_offer_pending
					}
				}
				VIE = { COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_implement = yes }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 50 }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_decline
		trigger = {
			tag = SVN
			VIE = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_offer_pending }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = SVN
				VIE = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_offer_pending }
			}
			VIE = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_offer_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_awaiting_response
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_DIP.241 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 50 }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_closed
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				tag = SVN
				VIE = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_offer_pending }
			}
		}
	}
}
